source_audit_support.citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 708

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 708, what minimum setback from the side and rear property lines must a Group A dwelling observe, in addition to the percent-of-site-occupancy and the Civil Code easements of light and view?

options.text: At least 2.00 m from every property line
At least 1.00 m from every property line
At least 3.00 m from every property line
At least 1.50 m from every property line

proposed.rationale: Section 708 requires a Group A dwelling to be set back at least 2.00 m from every property line. This minimum does not override the larger Civil Code easements of light and view, which apply on top of any code setback.
proposed.explanation: The 2.00 m setback is the PD 1096 minimum; it is layered with the 90 percent / 80 percent maximum lot occupancy and with any applicable easement from the Civil Code. The largest of the applicable distances governs.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 708
